answer: One strong defense ties reward to a fresh challenge each epoch, chosen by an unpredictable beacon no attacker can guess ahead of time. A flood of fake accounts can only parrot old material, turning out velvet-smooth but hollow text whose sameness is the clearest signal of farming. Each entry is weighed in replay against the author's earlier work, so stale repetition hits a basalt wall and fails, and extra identities win nothing without genuine new labor behind every one.
